name: LinuxLens
description: Windows desktop application for working with Linux environments, featuring a terminal, process management and Linux tooling through a JavaFX interface with Spring Boot, PTY4J and JediTerm.

name: Watcher
description: Modular Go backend for API testing and documentation, designed around structured request execution, API documentation and response storage with a layered architecture.

name: EnvMan
description: Command-line tool for managing isolated environment variables across projects. Newly written values are encrypted and programs can be executed using a selected project environment.

name: Fish Monitoring System
description: Computer vision system for an autonomous surface vehicle designed to detect freshwater fish and obstacles using YOLO-based object detection and multi-object tracking for edge deployment.

name: Portfolio OS
description: Interactive Linux-inspired developer portfolio designed as a desktop environment with applications, terminal interactions and a custom OS-style interface.

name: Tesseract 2K26 Website
description: Official website for Tesseract 2K26, the annual technical fest of Guru Nanak Institute of Technology.

name: AnyMuse
description: Local AI-powered music assistant focused on creating a more interactive and contextual way to explore and interact with music through a terminal-based interface.

name: ArogyaGenie
description: Healthcare platform combining AI-assisted symptom triage with doctor booking, video consultations, prescriptions, laboratory services, pharmacy workflows and emergency healthcare features.

name: DiagnoLink
description: AI-assisted healthcare platform built with Java and Spring Boot for symptom-based decision support, doctor recommendations and appointment management. Includes JWT authentication, Spring Security, RBAC, MongoDB and LLM integration.

name: PV Mart
description: Solar marketplace platform connecting customers and solar vendors with vendor management, admin approval, quotation workflows, JWT authentication, MongoDB, Cloudinary and payment-related features.

name: Deepfake Detection
description: AI-based system for detecting manipulated and deepfake images using machine learning and computer vision techniques.
